meaning: To make someone feel embarrassed or ashamed
trick: 'A'+'Bash' — सामने Bash (पीट) पड़े तो इंसान शर्मिंदा हो जाता है।
examples: His sharp comment abashed the young intern in front of the whole team.
A single loud laugh from the back row was enough to abash the nervous speaker.

meaning: To become less intense or widespread
trick: 'Ate' — बहुत खाना खा लिया तो भूख कम हो गई।
examples: The economic crisis shows no signs of abating anytime soon.
The floodwaters began to abate after three days, allowing families to return to their homes.

meaning: To give up a position, right, or power formally
trick: 'Ab'+'Dicate' — अब राजकाज संभालने में दिक्कत हो रही है इसलिए कुर्सी छोड़ दी।
examples: The CEO was forced to abdicate his position after the scandal.
Facing public pressure, the king chose to abdicate the throne in favour of his daughter.

meaning: To take someone away illegally by force
trick: 'Ab'+'Duct' — किसी को Duct (खींचकर) Ab (दूर) ले जाना।
examples: The fraudster tried to abduct the key witness before the trial.
Police believe the gang planned to abduct the businessman's son from outside his school.

meaning: A beginner learning the basics
trick: 'ABC' + 'Darian' — ABC सीखने वाला यानी बिल्कुल शुरुआती या नौसिखिया।
examples: Every expert was once an abecedarian in the banking field.
As an abecedarian in chess, she lost every game during her first week at the club.

meaning: Departing from normal standards or behavior
trick: 'Ab'+'Errant' — अब इसके व्यवहार में error आ गया है यानी असामान्य।
examples: His aberrant behavior during the meeting shocked everyone.
The scientist repeated the test because one aberrant reading did not match the rest of the data.

meaning: A state of temporary suspension
trick: 'अभी'+'Bye' — काम को अभी Bye बोल दिया, बाद में देखेंगे यानी अस्थायी रोक।
examples: The new policy has been kept in abeyance pending further review.
The football tournament was held in abeyance until the heavy monsoon had passed.

meaning: To renounce or reject a belief formally
trick: 'Ab'+'Jury' — Jury (जूरी) के सामने गलत काम से मुकर जाना।
examples: The defaulter was forced to abjure all claims on the disputed property.
At the ceremony, the former rebel agreed to abjure violence and join the peace process.

meaning: The act of washing oneself, often for religious reasons
trick: 'अब'+'Lotion' — पहले नहा-धो लो, फिर अब Lotion लगाओ यानी नहाना-धोना।
examples: Ritual ablution before prayers is common in many religions.
The pilgrims performed their morning ablutions in the cold river before entering the temple.

meaning: To renounce or give up something, especially a right or comfort
trick: 'अब ना'+'Get' — "मुझे अब कुछ नहीं Get करना" कहकर सब त्याग देना।
examples: The monk chose to abnegate all worldly pleasures and live simply.
The young doctor chose to abnegate a comfortable city life and serve in a remote village.

meaning: To abolish or annul formally
trick: 'Ab'+'Roko'+'Gate' — "अब इस नियम को गेट पर ही रोको!" कहकर पुराना कानून रद्द कर दिया।
examples: Both companies agreed to abrogate the old trade agreement.
Parliament voted to abrogate the outdated law that had been in force for a century.

meaning: The natural shedding of a plant part, or separation
trick: 'Abs'+'Scissors' — Scissors से काटकर अलग कर देना।
examples: Abscission of old leaves helps trees conserve energy in winter.
Gardeners noticed abscission in the maple tree as red leaves dropped one by one in autumn.

meaning: To leave secretly, especially to avoid arrest
trick: 'अब'+'Second' — पुलिस आई और चोर एक Second में फरार हो गया।
examples: The fraudster absconded with the investors' money before the audit.
The cashier tried to abscond with the day's cash, but the guard caught him at the gate.

meaning: To refrain from doing something
trick: 'Abs'+'Stain' — Stain (दाग) से दूर रहना यानी परहेज करना।
examples: Doctors advise patients to abstain from alcohol during treatment.
Several members chose to abstain from the vote because they had not read the proposal.

meaning: Not self-indulgent, especially in eating and drinking
trick: 'Abs'+'Team' — Abs बनाने वाली Team पिज़्ज़ा-मिठाई से दूर रहती है यानी संयमी।
examples: His abstemious lifestyle helped him live a long and healthy life.
The athlete was abstemious in his diet, avoiding sweets and fried food during training.

meaning: Difficult to understand; obscure
trick: 'अब'+'Stress' — Reasoning का इतना कठिन Puzzle देखकर अब Stress हो गया।
examples: The professor's lecture on quantum physics was too abstruse for the freshers.
Many students found the abstruse philosophy text impossible to follow without a teacher's guidance.

meaning: To agree to a request or demand
trick: 'Accept' — Accede ≈ Accept: किसी की बात Accept कर लेना यानी सहमत हो जाना।
examples: The management finally acceded to the workers' demand for higher wages.
After weeks of protest, the council agreed to accede to the villagers' request for a new bridge.

meaning: An award or expression of praise
trick: 'A'+'Collar' — Topper को सम्मान मिला तो उसने गर्व से Collar ऊँचा कर लिया।
examples: The scientist received a prestigious accolade for her breakthrough research.
The young cricketer's match-winning century earned him the highest accolade from the national board.

meaning: To approach and speak to someone boldly
trick: 'अकड़'+'Cost' — सेल्समैन ने रास्ता रोककर अकड़ से Cost बताना शुरू कर दिया।
examples: A salesman accosted me at the mall with an offer I didn't want.
A stranger accosted the tourists near the station and began asking them for money.

meaning: To accumulate or increase over time
trick: 'A'+'Crew' — जैसे-जैसे Crew (टीम) बढ़े, काम accumulate होता जाता है।
examples: Interest will accrue on your fixed deposit every quarter.
Benefits will accrue to the company as more customers adopt the new mobile app.

meaning: Sharp and biting in tone
trick: 'Acid' — जिसकी जुबान एसिड की तरह तीखी और कड़वी हो।
examples: The critic is known for his acerbic reviews of government budgets.
Her acerbic wit made the debate entertaining but left her opponents stung.

meaning: Full of anger and bitterness
trick: 'Crime' — जहाँ Crime होता है वहाँ रिश्तों में कड़वाहट आ जाती है।
examples: Their partnership ended in an acrimonious legal battle.
The divorce proceedings turned acrimonious when both sides began trading insults in court.

meaning: Keen insight and shrewd judgment
trick: 'I.Q.'+'Men' — जिन Men का IQ लेवल हाई होता है उनमें तेज़ बुद्धि होती है।
examples: His sharp business acumen helped turn the loss-making bank into a profitable one.
Her acumen in spotting talent helped the coach build a winning team.

meaning: Refusing to change one's mind; unyielding
trick: 'Aada'+'Man' — जो आदमी अपनी बात पर अड़ जाए वो अड़ियल होता है।
examples: The union leader is adamant about the wage hike.
The child was adamant that she would not eat vegetables, however much her mother pleaded.

meaning: To warn or reprimand firmly
trick: 'Ad(mi)'+'(Pu)nish' — आदमी को हल्की डाँट।
examples: The manager admonished the staff for coming late to the office.
The referee had to admonish the player for arguing after the final whistle.

meaning: To outline or indicate faintly
trick: 'A'+'Dumb'+'Rate' — Dumb (गूंगे) इशारों से किसी बात का संकेत देना।
examples: The chairman adumbrated the new policy in his opening remarks.
In his first speech, the new coach merely adumbrated his plans for the upcoming season.

meaning: Unfavorable or harmful
trick: 'Reverse' — जब हालात Reverse (उल्टे) चल रहे हों यानी विपरीत हों।
examples: Unseasonal rains had an adverse impact on the rural economy.
Adverse weather forced the airline to cancel all evening flights from the city.

meaning: A difficult or unpleasant situation
trick: 'Adverse'+'City' — विपरीत City में फँस जाएँ तो मुसीबत आ जाती है।
examples: He showed true leadership qualities during times of adversity.
Overcoming adversity in her childhood made her a strong and determined athlete.

meaning: To publicly support or recommend
trick: 'Ad'+'Vocate' — जो अपनी Voice उठाकर समर्थन करे।
examples: Many economists advocate for a reduction in corporate taxes.
The doctor continues to advocate daily exercise as the best way to prevent heart disease.

meaning: A natural liking or attraction
trick: 'A'+'Fine'+'ity' — Fine (अच्छा) लगने वाला स्वाभाविक जुड़ाव।
examples: She has a natural affinity for numbers, which helped her in banking.
The boy showed an early affinity for music and could play every tune he heard.

meaning: Wealthy; having a lot of money
trick: 'A'+'Fluent' — जो Fluent इंग्लिश बोलता है लोग मानते हैं अमीर घर से है।
examples: The new luxury mall is built in an affluent neighborhood.
Affluent families in the town often send their children to schools abroad.

meaning: An action or remark that causes offense
trick: 'A'+'Front' — सामने Front पर insult करना।
examples: His remark was seen as an affront to the entire department.
Being asked to wait outside after a long journey felt like an affront to the elderly guest.

meaning: Brisk and cheerful readiness
trick: 'Ek'+'Lakh' — अगर एक लाख का बोनस मिले तो बड़ी खुशी और तत्परता से काम करेगा।
examples: She accepted the job offer from the Reserve Bank with alacrity.
The volunteers responded with alacrity when the village called for help after the storm.

meaning: To diminish or relieve fear or concern
trick: 'A'+'Lay' — Lay (लेटाकर) डर को शांत करना।
examples: The RBI's assurance helped allay fears of a bank run.
The teacher tried to allay the students' worries by explaining the exam format clearly.

meaning: To claim without proof
trick: 'आरोप'+'लगे' — Allege ≈ "आरोप लगे": किसी पर बिना सबूत आरोप लगाना।
examples: The whistleblower alleged that the manager was involved in fraud.
Witnesses allege that the driver ignored the red signal before the collision.

meaning: To make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe
trick: 'All'+'Leave'+'Ate' — सब खा लिया तो भूख कम हो गई।
examples: The government's new policy will alleviate poverty in rural areas.
A cool compress can help alleviate the headache until the doctor arrives.

meaning: Selflessly concerned for others' well-being
trick: 'All'+'True' — जो सबके लिए सच्चा हो वो परोपकारी होता है।
examples: The billionaire's altruistic contributions helped build many hospitals.
Her altruistic nature led her to spend every weekend teaching poor children for free.

meaning: Open to more than one interpretation; unclear
trick: 'Ambi'+'Guess' — जिस बात का मतलब सिर्फ Guess करना पड़े, वो अस्पष्ट है।
examples: The government's ambiguous policy left investors confused.
The ambiguous road sign left the travellers unsure which turn led to the highway.

meaning: Having mixed or contradictory feelings
trick: 'Bi'+'Valentine' — Bi = दो (Bicycle)। दो Valentine में से किसे चुनूँ? दुविधा!
examples: Many employees remain ambivalent about the new work-from-home policy.
He felt ambivalent about leaving his hometown, excited for the job yet sad to go.

meaning: To make a bad situation better
trick: 'Amul'+'Rate' — अमूल दूध का रेट कम हो तो हालत सुधर जाएगी।
examples: Steps must be taken to ameliorate the living conditions of the poor.
New drainage canals were built to ameliorate the flooding that troubled the town every year.

meaning: Open and responsive to suggestion
trick: 'A'+'Mean'+'Able' — Mean (बुरा) न होकर सलाह मानने वाला।
examples: The board was amenable to the CEO's proposal for digital expansion.
The shopkeeper was amenable to lowering the price when we bought three items together.

meaning: Having a friendly and pleasant manner
trick: 'Ami' (Friend) + 'Able' — Friend जैसा प्यारा और मिलनसार।
examples: The amiable receptionist made every visitor feel welcome at the bank.
Our amiable neighbour greets everyone on the street with a warm smile.

meaning: Surrounded by; in the middle of
trick: 'Middle' — मिडल मतलब बीच में।
examples: The rupee strengthened amid global market uncertainties.
The bride walked down the aisle amid cheers and showers of flower petals.

meaning: Lacking a clear shape or form
trick: 'A'+'Morph' — अमीबा या पानी की तरह जिसका कोई निश्चित आकार न हो।
examples: The committee presented an amorphous plan with no clear timeline.
The amorphous cloud drifted across the sky without taking any clear shape.

hindi: कालदोष / समय से बाहर की वस्तु
meaning: Something out of its proper time period
trick: 'An'+'Chronological' — जो समय के क्रम में फिट ना हो, जैसे अकबर के हाथ में मोबाइल।
examples: Using physical ledgers in the age of cloud banking is an anachronism.
A knight carrying a mobile phone in the historical film was a glaring anachronism.

meaning: Strong hostility or hatred
trick: 'Enemy'+'City' — Enemy शहर में आ जाए तो दुश्मनी का माहौल बनता है।
examples: There is a deep historical animosity between the two rival companies.
Years of land disputes had created animosity between the two neighbouring families.

hindi: दर्द निवारक / मन को आराम देने वाला
meaning: A painkiller, or something that soothes the mind
trick: 'No'+'Dyne' ≈ 'No Pain' — जो दर्द ना दे, यानी दर्द-निवारक या हल्का-फीका।
examples: The CEO's speech was an anodyne message to calm the anxious shareholders.
The soft lullaby acted as an anodyne, calming the crying baby within minutes.

meaning: Something that deviates from the normal or expected
trick: 'Abnormal' — जो नॉर्मल ना हो वही Anomaly है।
examples: The sudden drop in stock prices was an anomaly.
Snow in the desert was a weather anomaly that surprised the local scientists.

meaning: A person who actively opposes someone
trick: 'Anti'+'Against' — जो आपके Against (विरुद्ध) खड़ा हो वो विरोधी है।
examples: In the novel, the cruel king is the main antagonist.
In the film, the antagonist keeps trying to stop the hero from reaching the village.

meaning: A deep-seated feeling of dislike
trick: 'Anti'+'Sympathy' — Sympathy (हमदर्दी) का उल्टा यानी गहरी नफरत।
examples: He has a natural antipathy toward corrupt officials.
She felt a strong antipathy toward crowded markets and avoided them whenever possible.

meaning: Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern
trick: 'No'+'Sympathy' — ना हमदर्दी, ना फर्क = उदासीनता।
examples: The growing voter apathy is a concern for a healthy democracy.
The apathy of residents meant that only ten people attended the cleanliness drive.

meaning: A short phrase expressing a general truth
trick: 'A'+'Formula' — ज़िंदगी का छोटा-सा Formula, जैसे "मेहनत का फल मीठा होता है"।
examples: The book opened with an old aphorism about the value of honesty.
My grandfather loved the aphorism that a stitch in time saves nine.

meaning: Self-confidence in a difficult situation
trick: 'आप'+'Bomb' — Bomb जैसा Confidence।
examples: The bank manager handled the angry crowd with remarkable aplomb.
The young singer carried on with aplomb even after the microphone suddenly stopped working.

meaning: Of doubtful authenticity, though widely believed
trick: 'A'+'Copy'+'Real' — जिसकी कोई Real Copy न हो यानी मनगढ़ंत।
examples: The story of the founder's lucky coin is probably apocryphal.
The tale that the famous scientist failed maths at school is likely apocryphal.

meaning: The highest point of development; culmination
trick: 'Aap'+'Top' — आप अपने करियर के सबसे Top (चरम शिखर) पर पहुँच गए।
examples: Becoming the RBI Governor was the apotheosis of his long banking career.
Winning the Olympic gold was the apotheosis of her years of hard training.

meaning: To pacify by giving in to demands
trick: 'App'+'Please' — गुस्साए इंसान को Please बोलकर शांत करते हैं।
examples: The management offered a bonus to appease the angry workers.
The mother gave the toddler a toy to appease him during the long train ride.

meaning: Anxious about something that might happen
trick: 'Ab'+'Tension' — रिजल्ट से पहले मन में जो डर और टेंशन होती है।
examples: Small shopkeepers are apprehensive about the impact of the new tax rules.
The new student felt apprehensive on the first day, fearing nobody would talk to her.

meaning: To inform or notify
trick: 'App'+'Rise' — App का Notification यानी सूचना देना।
examples: The bank must apprise customers of any change in interest rates.
Please apprise the passengers of the delay as soon as the engineer reports back.

meaning: Approval or praise
trick: 'Approval'+'ation' — Approval (मंजूरी) की भावना।
examples: The new policy met with the approbation of the entire board.
The villagers expressed their approbation of the new school with loud applause.

meaning: Based on random choice rather than reason
trick: 'अब'+'Try' — कोई नियम नहीं, "अब जो मन करे Try करो" यानी मनमाना।
examples: The boss made an arbitrary decision to fire three employees.
The strict rule seemed arbitrary because nobody could explain why it was introduced.

meaning: Very old or outdated
trick: 'Archeology' — पुरातत्व में मिली चीज़ें बहुत प्राचीन होती हैं।
examples: The banking system is running on archaic technology that needs an upgrade.
The judge used archaic words that most people in the courtroom no longer understood.

meaning: To claim something without the right to do so
trick: 'Arrogant'+'Gate' — घमंडी आदमी ने बिना हक के Gate पर कब्ज़ा कर लिया।
examples: He tried to arrogate to himself the credit for the whole team's work.
The new monitor tried to arrogate the right to punish classmates without asking the teacher.

meaning: Able to express ideas clearly and fluently
trick: 'Art'+'Clear' — जो अपनी बात को Art की तरह Clear और साफ शब्दों में बोले।
examples: An officer must be able to articulate complex financial policies to rural customers.
The articulate young debater explained her point so clearly that even the judges nodded.

meaning: Practicing severe self-discipline and abstaining from worldly pleasures
trick: 'Aastha'+'Tick' — जो दुनिया के सुख छोड़कर सिर्फ आस्था में टिक जाए वो तपस्वी है।
examples: Despite his immense wealth, the founder lived an ascetic life.
The ascetic lived in a mountain cave, eating only fruits and owning nothing.

hindi: टेढ़ी नज़र से देखना / संदेह से
meaning: With suspicion or disapproval
trick: 'Ask'+'Glance' — शक भरी तिरछी Glance डालना।
examples: The auditor looked askance at the sudden rise in transactions.
Villagers looked askance at the stranger who wandered the lanes at midnight.

meaning: To attack violently or criticize strongly
trick: 'Assault' — Assail ≈ Assault यानी ज़ोरदार हमला।
examples: Doubts assailed him the moment he signed the risky loan.
Critics continued to assail the film for its slow pace and weak ending.

meaning: Showing great care and persistence
trick: 'Ass' — गधे की तरह बिना रुके लगातार मेहनत करने वाला।
examples: She was very assiduous in preparing for her banking exams.
The assiduous gardener watered each plant daily and was rewarded with a splendid harvest.

meaning: To absorb into a group, or understand fully
trick: 'A'+'Similar' — Similar (एक जैसा) बना लेना।
examples: New recruits need time to assimilate the bank's work culture.
It took the immigrant family a year to assimilate into their new neighbourhood.

hindi: कम करना / शांत करना (दर्द या डर)
meaning: To soothe or relieve pain or fear
trick: 'Aansu'+'Ponch' — किसी के आँसू पोंछकर उसके दुख और दर्द को कम करना।
examples: The RBI issued a statement to assuage the fears of depositors.
A cup of warm milk and a kind word helped assuage the child's fear of thunder.

meaning: Clever and quick to see how to gain advantage
trick: 'A'+'Student' — अच्छा Student हमेशा चतुर और समझदार होता है।
examples: An astute investor always studies the market trends before investing.
The astute shopkeeper noticed the fake note immediately and refused to accept it.

meaning: Calmness; freedom from anxiety
trick: 'आ, तारा'+'Relax' — आ, छत पर तारे देख और Relax कर, मन एकदम शांत।
examples: She faced the crisis with remarkable ataraxia, never raising her voice.
Years of meditation had given the old monk an ataraxia that no insult could disturb.

meaning: To reduce in force, value, or intensity
trick: 'Attention'+'Ate' — जब पढ़ाई से Attention हट जाए तो तैयारी कमजोर पड़ जाती है।
examples: New security software was installed to attenuate the risk of cyber attacks.
Thick walls help attenuate the noise from the busy highway outside the school.

meaning: Gradual reduction through sustained pressure
trick: 'आटा पिसना' — गेहूँ धीरे-धीरे घिसकर आटा बनता है।
examples: Employee attrition is a major concern for private banks.
The long war of attrition left both armies short of food and soldiers.

meaning: Willing to take bold risks; daring
trick: 'Audi' — ऑडी चलाने वाले निडर होकर साहसी ड्राइविंग करते हैं।
examples: Launching a startup during a recession was an audacious move.
The audacious climber attempted the icy peak without a guide or extra oxygen.

meaning: To predict or indicate a future event
trick: 'आगे'+'गुरु' — गुरुजी आगे क्या होगा उसका संकेत पहले ही दे देते हैं।
examples: The strong quarterly numbers augur well for the bank's future.
Dark clouds and a falling barometer augur a heavy storm by evening.

meaning: Severely simple; strict in manner or appearance
trick: 'O'+'Saint' — साधु-संतों का रहन-सहन बहुत सादा और नियमों में सख्त होता है।
examples: Growing up in an austere household taught him the value of saving money.
The monastery's austere rooms held only a wooden bed and a single lamp.

meaning: Extreme simplicity or reduction in spending
trick: 'O'+'Stair' — "O! बिजली बचाओ, Lift नहीं Stairs से चलो" यानी खर्च में कटौती।
examples: The government implemented austerity measures to cut costs.
During the years of austerity, the family wore old clothes and rarely dined out.

meaning: A strong dislike or disinclination
trick: 'Avoid'+'Version' — जिस चीज़ से Aversion (घृणा) हो, उसे हम Avoid करते हैं।
examples: He has a strong aversion to taking risks in the stock market.
He has an aversion to heights and refuses to ride the Ferris wheel.

meaning: To declare openly
trick: 'A'+'Vow' — Vow (कसम) खाकर साफ-साफ स्वीकार करना।
examples: The CEO avowed his commitment to transparency during the press meet.
The young prince did avow his loyalty to the people before the assembled crowd.

meaning: A self-evident truth
trick: 'Exam' — "मेहनत करोगे तो Exam पास होगा" यह एक स्वयंसिद्ध सत्य है।
examples: "Higher risk brings higher return" is a basic axiom of investing.
It is an axiom of physics that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

meaning: Characterized by drunken revelry
trick: 'बच्चा'+'नाली' — पार्टी में इतना हुड़दंग हुआ कि लोग नाली में गिरे पड़े थे।
examples: The bacchanalian celebrations after the merger lasted all night.
Neighbours complained about the bacchanalian party that carried on loudly until the early morning.

meaning: A thing of little value; a game
trick: 'बक-बक'+'Tell' — बेकार की बकबक Tell करना यानी मामूली, तुच्छ बात।
examples: To a billionaire, losing a few thousand dollars is a mere bagatelle.
Spending a hundred rupees on tea seemed a mere bagatelle compared with the big wedding expenses.

meaning: Wet, dirty and in a messy state
trick: 'Bed'+'Dragged' — Bed से Dragged (घसीटकर) गंदा।
examples: The bedraggled traveller stumbled into the bank seeking help.
The bedraggled puppy shivered at our door after wandering through the muddy rain.

meaning: To happen to someone, often something unpleasant
trick: 'Be'+'Fall' — जो Fall (गिरना) निश्चित हो वो होकर ही रहता है।
examples: Nobody knew what would befall the market after the announcement.
The old fable warns of the misfortune that will befall those who ignore good advice.

meaning: To envy someone's success, or give reluctantly
trick: 'Be'+'Grudge' — Grudge (ईर्ष्या) के साथ देना।
examples: Nobody begrudged the honest officer his well- deserved promotion.
I do not begrudge my sister her success; she worked harder than anyone.

meaning: A huge or monstrous creature or organization
trick: 'Big'+'Mammoth' — Mammoth (विशाल हाथी) जैसा बहुत बड़ा यानी विशालकाय।
examples: The giant bank emerged as a behemoth after the merger.
The ship was a behemoth that dwarfed every other vessel in the harbour.

hindi: झूठा साबित करना / गलत धारणा देना
meaning: To contradict or show to be false
trick: 'Be'+'Lie' — किसी बात या दिखने वाले भाव को Lie (झूठा) साबित कर देना।
examples: The company's flashy advertisements belie its poor financial health.
His calm smile could not belie the nervousness shown by his trembling hands.

meaning: To make someone feel unimportant
trick: 'Be'+'Little' — किसी को Little (छोटा) बना देना।
examples: A good mentor never belittles a junior's ideas.
Teachers should never belittle a child who gives a wrong answer in class.

meaning: Demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight
trick: 'Bully'+'Cause' — Bully (दबंग) बिना किसी Cause के लड़ने को तैयार रहता है।
examples: His bellicose statements escalated the tension between the two countries.
The bellicose general kept demanding war even when the council urged peace talks.

meaning: Hostile and aggressive; eager to fight
trick: 'Billi'+'Ghurrana' — बिल्ली की तरह जो हमेशा गुर्राता रहे और लड़ने को तैयार रहे।
examples: The belligerent defaulter started arguing with the loan recovery agents.
The belligerent passenger shouted at the conductor and refused to show his ticket.

meaning: A person or thing that leads or indicates a trend
trick: 'Bell'+'Weather' — Bell बजे तो सब पीछे चलें, Weather आगे का हाल बताए = अगुआ।
examples: The bank's policy is seen as a bellwether for the entire sector.
The results of this small town's election are often a bellwether for the national vote.

meaning: To express discontent or sorrow
trick: 'Be'+'Moan' — Moan (कराहना) के साथ शिकायत करना।
examples: Economists bemoan the lack of skilled manpower in rural banking.
Older residents bemoan the loss of green fields that once surrounded their village.

meaning: Generous in doing good deeds
trick: 'Benefit'+'Saint' — संत की तरह जो हमेशा दूसरों का Benefit (भला) करे।
examples: The beneficent trust opened free coaching centers for underprivileged students.
The beneficent queen opened her granaries to feed the famine-stricken villagers.

meaning: Kind, generous, and caring
trick: 'Bina'+'Violent' — जो आदमी कभी Violent न हो वो बहुत दयालु होता है।
examples: The benevolent donor gave millions to the orphanage.
A benevolent old teacher paid the fees of several poor students every year.

meaning: Gentle, kind, and not harmful
trick: 'Be'+'Nice' — जो हमेशा Nice रहे, वो सौम्य और हानिरहित होता है।
examples: The doctor assured him that the tumor was benign.
The benign breeze of the spring evening made the long walk pleasant.

meaning: To leave something to someone in a will
trick: 'Be'+'Quit' — दुनिया Quit करने से पहले संपत्ति वसीयत में दे जाना।
examples: The founder bequeathed his entire estate to the bank's charity fund.
She decided to bequeath her library to the town school after her death.

meaning: Deprived of something valuable
trick: 'Be'+'Left' — सब छोड़कर चले गए, अकेला Left रह गया यानी वंचित।
examples: The bereft widow struggled to raise her children after her husband's death.
The team was bereft of hope after losing their captain just before the final.

meaning: To beg or implore someone earnestly
trick: 'Be'+'Seek' — हाथ जोड़कर मदद Seek करना यानी गिड़गिड़ाकर विनती करना।
examples: The farmer beseeched the bank to extend his loan repayment period.
The mother did beseech the guard to let her see her sick son.

meaning: To give as a gift or honor
trick: 'Best'+'Show' — Show में Best को अवॉर्ड प्रदान करना।
examples: The RBI bestowed a lifetime achievement award on the retired governor.
The university will bestow an honorary degree on the famous author next month.

hindi: झुंड / समूह (पक्षियों या सुंदर लड़कियों का)
meaning: A large group of people or things of a particular kind
trick: 'बीवी' — शादी में बीवी (Bevy) अपनी सहेलियों का पूरा झुंड लेकर आई।
examples: A bevy of young graduates applied for the banking job.
A bevy of reporters surrounded the winning athlete as she left the stadium.

meaning: To divide into two branches
trick: 'Bi' (दो) + 'Fork' — Fork की तरह दो रास्तों में बंट जाना।
examples: The bank decided to bifurcate its operations into retail and corporate wings.
The river appears to bifurcate near the hills, with one branch heading east and the other south.

meaning: A person intolerant of others' views
trick: 'Big'+'Got' — जो अपने Big (बड़े) विचार को Got (पकड़) कर बैठ जाए।
examples: A bigot cannot accept new ideas, no matter how sound they are.
The bigot refused to sit beside anyone from a different community, however polite they were.

meaning: Irritable and bad-tempered
trick: 'Bile' (पित्त) — जिसका पित्त बढ़ा हुआ हो और वो चिड़चिड़ा हो।
examples: The bilious manager snapped at everyone who came near his desk.
A bilious mood hung over the household after the long and fruitless search for the keys.

meaning: A temporary camp without tents or cover
trick: 'बीहड़'+'Walk' — बीहड़ में दिनभर Walk करके सैनिक रात को बिना टेंट के अस्थायी कैंप लगाते हैं।
examples: The soldiers bivouacked near the border during the military exercise.
The mountaineers had to bivouac on the ledge when darkness fell before they reached the camp.

meaning: Unimpressed or indifferent because one has experienced it many times
trick: 'Blah-blah, जाने दो' — सब कुछ इतनी बार देख चुका है कि हर नई चीज़ पर बस यही कहता है।
examples: After years of traveling, she was blasé about visiting new countries.
The seasoned traveller was blase about airport delays that made everyone else furious.

meaning: Done openly without shame
trick: 'Blast'+'Ant' — Blast करके सबको दिखाने वाला स्पष्ट झूठ।
examples: The company's blatant disregard for safety rules led to the accident.
It was a blatant lie, and everyone in the room knew the truth.

meaning: To spoil or destroy something
trick: 'Bright' का उल्टा — जो Bright (चमक) छीन ले।
examples: Corruption can blight the future of an entire generation.
A fungal blight swept through the potato fields and ruined the farmers' harvest.

meaning: Showing a casual and cheerful indifference
trick: 'बे'+'Light' — बेफ़िक्र और Light (हल्का) मन, कोई टेंशन नहीं।
examples: Her blithe attitude toward deadlines annoyed the entire team.
With a blithe wave, he left for the trip without checking the weather or the map.

hindi: मोटी लाठी से मारना / ज़बरदस्ती करना
meaning: To hit with a heavy object; to force someone
trick: 'Blood'+'Gun' — लाठी से मारकर Blood निकालना।
examples: The criminals tried to bludgeon the guard into silence.
In the old tale, the giant would bludgeon the gates with a huge wooden club.

meaning: To talk loudly and aggressively without real effect
trick: 'Blue'+'Storm' — Blue Storm की तरह ज़ोरदार शोर, पर कुछ नहीं।
examples: The manager blustered about strict action but never followed through.
He could only bluster angrily when the umpire rejected his appeal.

meaning: Noisy, energetic, and rough
trick: 'Boys'+'Terror' — हॉस्टल के Boys शोर मचाते हैं तो टेरर फैलता है।
examples: The boisterous crowd cheered loudly as India won the match.
The boisterous children raced around the garden, shouting and tumbling over each other.

meaning: To support, strengthen, or reinforce
trick: 'Booster' — बूस्टर डोज से इम्युनिटी मजबूत होती है।
examples: The merger will bolster the bank's capital base.
Extra training sessions will bolster the team's confidence before the final match.

meaning: High-sounding but with little meaning
trick: 'Bomb'+'Blast' — जो बातों में बम ब्लास्ट की तरह बड़े शब्द फेंके पर काम कुछ न करे।
examples: Voters were tired of the politician's bombastic speeches and wanted real jobs.
The bombastic announcer promised the greatest show on earth but delivered a dull performance.

meaning: Rude and ill-mannered
trick: 'Bore' (बोर) + 'ish' — बोर करने वाला गँवार व्यवहार।
examples: His boorish behaviour at the client meeting cost the company the deal.
It was boorish of him to answer his phone loudly during the funeral.

meaning: A wealthy, fashionable socialite
trick: 'बुलावा'+'Daily' — इतना अमीर और फ़ैशनेबल कि हर पार्टी से Daily बुलावा आता है।
examples: The boulevardier was a regular at all the high- profile banking galas.
Dressed in a silk scarf, the boulevardier strolled the avenue greeting everyone he knew.

meaning: To remove offensive content from a text
trick: 'Bold'+'Erase' — किताब से Bold (गंदे/अश्लील) हिस्से Erase कर देना।
examples: The publisher decided to bowdlerize the old novel for school use.
The editor chose to bowdlerize the classic tales so that younger children could read them.

meaning: Concise and exact use of words
trick: 'Brief' — बात को छोटे में खत्म करना यानी संक्षिप्तता।
examples: The brevity of his speech was appreciated by everyone in the hall.
The poet is famous for brevity, saying a great deal in only a few lines.

meaning: To raise a subject for discussion
trick: 'Broad'+'Teach' — Broad (खुलकर) किसी विषय को Teach करना यानी चर्चा शुरू करना।
examples: The finance minister broached the topic of subsidy reform at the meeting.
I did not know how to broach the subject of moving to another city with my parents.

meaning: To intimidate with stern looks or words
trick: 'Brow'+'Beat' — भौंहें (Brow) चढ़ाकर Beat (धमकाना)।
examples: The senior tried to browbeat the trainee into signing a false report.
The coach would browbeat young players until they were afraid to speak at all.

meaning: Abrupt or blunt in manner
trick: 'Brisk'+'Blunt' — Brisk (तेज़) और Blunt (रूखा) बर्ताव।
examples: His brusque reply offended the customers waiting in line.
The clerk gave a brusque nod and returned to his files without a greeting.

meaning: Cheerful, optimistic, or able to float
trick: 'Boy'+'Ant' — लड़का चींटी जैसा एनर्जी से भरा है।
examples: Stock markets remained buoyant after the RBI announcement.
The buoyant mood in the dressing room continued after the team's third straight win.

meaning: Having a plump and attractive figure (typically of a woman)
trick: 'Box'+'Some' — Box की तरह भरी-भरी (plump) काया।
examples: The buxom actress was chosen for the role of the queen.
The sculptor carved a buxom figure of the village goddess from a single block of stone.

meaning: The state of being respected or admired; prestige
trick: 'Cash' + 'Set' — जब आप Cash और Set (तैयार) होते हैं, तो आपकी बात का एक अलग रुतबा होता है।
examples: Having an MBA from a top college adds cachet to your resume.
A degree from that old university carries a certain cachet in the world of publishing.

meaning: To laugh loudly and immoderately
trick: 'काका'+'Nate' — काका जोक सुनकर इतनी ज़ोर से ठहाका लगाते हैं कि पूरा घर गूँज जाए।
examples: The comedian's joke made the entire audience cachinnate.
The children began to cachinnate when the clown slipped on the banana peel.

meaning: Loud, uncontrolled laughter
trick: 'काका'+'Nation' — काका का ठहाका पूरी Nation में गूँजे = ज़ोर की हँसी।
examples: The cachinnation from the next room interrupted the serious meeting.
Sudden cachinnation from the audience made the nervous actor forget his next line.

meaning: A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds
trick: 'काक'+'Phone' — काँव-काँव + बजता Phone।
examples: A cacophony of horns greeted the minister as he entered the traffic jam.
A cacophony of barking dogs and honking cars woke the whole street at dawn.

meaning: A dead body
trick: 'कड़ा'+'Over' — शरीर कड़ा, ज़िंदगी Over = लाश।
examples: The forensic team examined the cadaver to determine the cause of death.
Medical students study a cadaver to learn how the human body is organised.

meaning: Resembling a corpse in being very pale, thin, or bony
trick: 'Cadaver' (लाश) — बीमारी या भूख से शरीर लाश जैसा पीला और दुबला हो जाना।
examples: The long illness left him with a cadaverous appearance.
The cadaverous prisoner could barely stand after months without proper food or sunlight.

meaning: To persuade someone through flattery
trick: 'Kajol' — काजोल की तरह मीठी बातें करके और मक्खन लगाकर मनाना।
examples: The agent tried to cajole the retired officer into buying a risky insurance plan.
She tried to cajole her father into lending her the car for the weekend.

meaning: Persuasion through flattery
trick: 'Kajol'+'ry' — काजोल जैसी मीठी बातों से मनाने का तरीका।
examples: No amount of cajolery could convince the auditor to hide the fraud.
With gentle cajolery, the nurse got the frightened boy to take his medicine.

meaning: Insensitive and unfeeling toward others' suffering
trick: 'Kala'+'Dil' — जिसका दिल पत्थर जैसा सख्त और काला हो।
examples: The management was criticized for its callous attitude toward laid-off workers.
It was callous of the driver to speed away without helping the injured cyclist.

meaning: Mutual trust and friendship among people
trick: 'Kamra'+'Yaari' — एक ही कमरे में साथ रहने वाले दोस्तों के बीच गहरी दोस्ती और भाईचारा।
examples: A strong sense of camaraderie among branch staff improves productivity.
The camaraderie among the climbers grew stronger with every cold night on the mountain.

hindi: गुप्त गुट / सलाहकारों का गुप्त समूह
meaning: A small group of people who scheme and plot in secret
trick: 'Kamra' (कमरा) + 'Lila' (लीला) — कमरे के अंदर गुप्त रूप से चलने वाली साजिशों की लीला।
examples: The king was heavily influenced by a camarilla of corrupt advisors.
A camarilla of loyal friends controlled access to the ailing leader and decided who could meet him.

meaning: A false or unfounded rumor or story
trick: 'कान'+'Ard' — कान में पड़ी सुनी-सुनाई बात, जो कान से कान फैले = झूठी अफ़वाह।
examples: The report that the bank was going bankrupt was a complete canard.
The rumour that the school would close for a month proved to be a canard.

meaning: Honest and direct in speech
trick: 'Candid Photo' जैसा — बिना बनावट, सच्चा।
examples: Let us have a candid discussion about the company's financial problems.
The coach gave a candid assessment of the team's weak defence after the defeat.

meaning: Having a lot of space
trick: 'Capacity' — जिसमें Capacity (क्षमता) भरपूर हो।
examples: The capacious vault of the bank can hold lakhs of gold coins.
She pulled a capacious bag from the cupboard and packed everything for the trip.

meaning: To surrender to an opponent or demand
trick: 'Cap'+'उतार' — टोपी (Cap) उतारकर सिर झुका देना = हार मान लेना।
examples: The management finally capitulated to the workers' demands after a long strike.
After a long siege, the starving city had no choice but to capitulate.

meaning: Given to sudden changes in mood or behavior
trick: 'Capri' — आजकल लड़के कभी फुल पैंट कभी कैप्री पहनते हैं।
examples: Capricious weather makes it difficult to plan an outdoor trip.
The capricious king would reward a servant one day and punish him the next.

hindi: नुक्ताचीन / हर बात में गलती निकालने वाला
meaning: Tending to find faults in everything
trick: 'Capture'+'ious' — हर छोटी गलती Capture करके टोकने वाला।
examples: His captious nature made team meetings stressful for everyone.
A captious critic, he found something to complain about in every dish at the feast.

meaning: Of the greatest importance; fundamental
trick: 'Card'+'Final' — Final Card जैसी सबसे मुख्य बात।
examples: Honesty is the cardinal principle of the banking profession.
Punctuality is the cardinal rule in our school, and late arrivals are always noted.

meaning: A comically exaggerated imitation
trick: 'Carry'+'Character' — किसी Character को Carry करके उसकी अजीब नकल बनाना।
examples: The magazine's caricature of the CEO caused a stir in the industry.
The cartoonist drew a caricature of the mayor with an enormous nose and tiny eyes.

meaning: Widespread slaughter of people
trick: 'Car'+'Rage' — Car में Rage (गुस्सा) से हुआ खून- खराबा।
examples: The war caused unimaginable carnage across the border towns.
Rescue workers were shocked by the carnage left on the highway after the multiple collision.

meaning: Constantly complaining about minor issues
trick: 'Car'+'Ping' — WhatsApp पर बार-बार Ping करके छोटी-छोटी बातों की शिकायत करना।
examples: Constant carping from the manager demoralized the entire staff.
His carping about the food, the room and the weather spoiled everyone's holiday.

meaning: To reprimand or criticize severely
trick: 'कस के'+'Get out!' — टीचर ने कस के डाँटा और बोले 'Get out!' = कड़ी फटकार।
examples: The Supreme Court castigated the authorities for failing to stop bank frauds.
The coach did castigate his players harshly for their careless mistakes in the semi-final.

hindi: भावनात्मक राहत / मन का बोझ उतरना
meaning: The process of releasing strong emotions for relief
trick: 'Katha' (कथा) — भगवान की कथा सुनकर मन का सारा बोझ उतर जाता है।
examples: Writing in a journal can be a cathartic experience for stress relief.
For the grieving widow, a long cry in her sister's arms brought a moment of catharsis.

hindi: शुद्धिकारी / मन का बोझ हल्का करने वाला
meaning: Providing emotional release and relief
trick: 'Katha' — भगवान की कथा सुनकर मन का सारा बोझ उतर जाता है।
examples: Talking openly about his exam failure was a cathartic experience for him.
Painting the stormy sea was a cathartic way for the artist to release her sadness.

meaning: A private meeting of a political party or group
trick: 'कौन-कौन'+'Discuss' — पार्टी के चुने हुए लोग बंद कमरे में Discuss करते हैं कि टिकट किसे मिलेगा।
examples: The party caucus met to decide its candidate for the election.
The senators held a closed caucus to settle their stance before the debate began.

meaning: Careful to avoid potential problems
trick: 'Caution' — रास्ते पर कौशन बोर्ड देखकर सतर्क हो जाना चाहिए।
examples: Banks are being highly cautious about lending money to real estate developers.
Be cautious while crossing the old wooden bridge, as several planks are rotten.

meaning: A warning or condition attached to an agreement
trick: 'Cave' — गुफा में जाने से पहले चेतावनी दी जाती है।
examples: The loan approval comes with a major caveat regarding repayment.
The offer of free tickets came with one caveat: they were valid only on weekdays.

meaning: Swiftness of action or movement
trick: 'Celerio'+'Accelerator' — गाड़ी का एक्सीलरेटर दबाते ही तेज़ी और फुर्ती आ जाती है।
examples: The fire brigade responded with great celerity to save the bank records.
The waiter moved with celerity, serving every table before the film began.

meaning: Related to the brain or intellectual activity
trick: 'Cerebrum' (Brain) — Brain से जुड़ा हुआ।
examples: The debate was too cerebral for casual viewers to enjoy.
Chess is a cerebral game that rewards patience and careful planning over speed.

meaning: Deep blue like a clear sky
trick: 'Sea'+'Rule' — समुद्र और आसमान जैसा नीला।
examples: The cerulean sky of the mountain resort refreshed everyone.
Her cerulean dress matched the colour of the sea at midday.

meaning: A person who falsely claims special knowledge or skill
trick: 'Charla' = 'छल' — छल करके खुद को Expert बताने वाला ढोंगी (नकली बाबा, नकली डॉक्टर)।
examples: The financial charlatan cheated hundreds of investors with a fake scheme.
The charlatan sold bottles of coloured water, claiming they could cure every disease.

meaning: The use of clever tricks to deceive
trick: 'Shikari' — शिकारी जैसे जाल बिछाता है वैसे पैसों के मामले में हेराफेरी करना।
examples: The audit exposed the financial chicanery used to hide the company's debts.
The politician won the seat through chicanery, including forged ballots and false promises.

meaning: Wildly fanciful; imaginary
trick: 'Camera'+'cal' — Filter वाली नकली दुनिया।
examples: The idea of doubling income overnight is a chimerical dream.
His chimerical plan to build a city on the clouds made everyone laugh.

meaning: The arrangement of events in time order
trick: 'Chrono' (Time) + 'logy' — Time के हिसाब से क्रम।
examples: The auditor reconstructed the chronology of transactions to find the fraud.
Students must learn the chronology of the freedom struggle, from the early revolts to independence.

meaning: Relating to the underworld; infernal
trick: 'Thon' = 'Down' — धरती के नीचे, पाताल का।
examples: The ritual invoked chthonic deities of the deep earth.
The old myth speaks of chthonic spirits that dwell in caverns beneath the mountain.

meaning: Rude and unfriendly in behavior
trick: 'चुड़ैल'+'ish' — चुड़ैल जैसा रूखा और असभ्य बर्ताव।
examples: It would be churlish to refuse a simple favor from a long-time colleague.
It seemed churlish to complain about the food when our hosts had worked so hard.

meaning: A married woman's male companion (while her husband is away)
trick: 'छी-छी'+'Beo' — पति बाहर हो और कोई और आदमी शादीशुदा औरत के साथ घूमे, तो लोग कहें 'छी-छी!'
examples: In the 18th century, a cicisbeo was an accepted part of high society.
The countess was often seen at the opera with her cicisbeo while her husband travelled abroad.

meaning: Very dark; gloomy
trick: 'SIM'+'मर गई' — SIM मर गई, फ़ोन बंद = घोर अंधेरा।
examples: The Cimmerian basement felt like a different, colder world.
A Cimmerian gloom filled the forest at midday, hiding the path from the weary hikers.

meaning: To find a way around a rule or problem
trick: 'Circle' — गोल-गोल बातें घुमा कर असल मुद्दे को चकमा दे देना।
examples: Clever accountants always find ways to circumvent tax laws.
Some drivers take the narrow lanes to circumvent the heavy traffic on the main road.

meaning: Kept secret or done secretively
trick: 'कल'+'दस'+'Tin' — कल रात दस बजे, Tin के शेड में छुपकर गुप्त मीटिंग।
examples: The RBI uncovered a clandestine operation to launder money through shell companies.
The two lovers held clandestine meetings in the garden, hoping no one would notice.

meaning: Mercy shown toward an offender
trick: 'Calm'+'Mann' — शांत और बड़े मन से किसी अपराधी पर दया दिखाना।
examples: The defaulter appealed to the bank board for clemency and extra time to pay.
The judge showed clemency toward the young offender because it was his first mistake.

meaning: Excessively sweet or sentimental
trick: 'खोया'+'ing' — ज़्यादा खोये की मिठाई से जी भर जाना।
examples: The cloying dialogue in the advertisement made it hard to watch.
The cloying perfume filled the small room and gave several guests a headache.

meaning: To come together and form one mass
trick: 'Coal' — छोटे-छोटे कोयले के टुकड़े आपस में मिलकर एक बड़ा ढेर बन गए।
examples: Several small rural banks decided to coalesce into a single strong entity.
Small streams coalesce into a mighty river as they flow down the valley.

meaning: A concluding event or passage in a piece of music or literature
trick: 'खुदा (हाफ़िज़)' — हर गाने या कहानी के आखिर में 'खुदा हाफ़िज़' = अंतिम भाग।
examples: The final act of the play served as a fitting coda to the epic trilogy.
The singer added a quiet coda to the concert, ending the evening on a gentle note.

meaning: Clear, logical, and convincing
trick: 'Court'+'Gent' — कोर्ट में Gentleman वकील के ऐसे ठोस तर्क कि जज भी मान जाए।
examples: The analyst presented a cogent argument for investing in green energy.
The lawyer's cogent reasoning convinced the jury that the accused could not have been there.

meaning: To think deeply about something
trick: 'खोज'+'इतनी' — दिमाग में इतनी खोज कि गहराई से सोचते रहो।
examples: The board cogitated for weeks before approving the merger plan.
The old chess master would sit and cogitate for an hour before moving a single pawn.

meaning: Aware or conscious of something
trick: 'कौन नहीं जानता?' — 'मुझे सब पता है' = अवगत (Aware)।
examples: The committee must be cognizant of the risks before approving the merger.
Drivers must be cognizant of speed limits near schools and hospitals.

meaning: Logical and consistent
trick: 'Co'+'Here' — जो बातें एक साथ जुड़कर साफ समझ आएं।
examples: The candidate provided a very clear and coherent answer during the interview.
The witness gave a coherent account of the accident, with every detail in the right order.

meaning: Secret cooperation for a deceitful purpose
trick: 'Kallu'+'Planning' — कल्लू ने चोरों के साथ गुप्त साँठ- गाँठ करके दुकान लुटवा दी।
examples: The loan scam happened due to collusion between the builder and corrupt officials.
The referee was suspended after proof of collusion with the gamblers emerged.

meaning: A peddler of books
trick: 'Cool' + 'Porter' — जो कूली (पोर्टर) की तरह किताबों का बोझ लेकर घूमे और बेचे।
examples: The colporteur sold religious books to the villagers.
A colporteur travelled from village to village on foot, carrying a sack of cheap books.

meaning: Corresponding in size or degree
trick: 'Common'+'Rate' — जैसा काम और अनुभव होगा उसी के अनुरूप सैलरी का रेट होगा।
examples: Salary will be commensurate with the candidate's qualifications and experience.
The punishment should be commensurate with the crime, not harsher than the offence deserves.

meaning: A threat of punishment
trick: 'Command'+'Nation' — पूरे Nation को Command: 'नियम तोड़ा तो सज़ा मिलेगी' = धमकी।
examples: The dictator issued a commination against anyone who opposed his rule.
The priest's fiery commination warned the sinners of the terrible fate awaiting them.

meaning: A comprehensive collection of information
trick: 'Complete'+'Medium' — Complete जानकारी का Medium यानी संग्रह।
examples: The RBI publishes a compendium of all banking regulations annually.
The library keeps a compendium of folk tales from every region of the country.

meaning: Overly self-satisfied and unaware of danger
trick: 'Come'+'Place' — अपनी मनचाही Place पर आकर आत्मसंतुष्ट हो गया।
examples: The bank cannot afford to be complacent despite the recent profits.
Having won twice already, the champions became complacent and lost the third match.

hindi: दूसरों को खुश करने वाला / मेहरबान / विनयपूर्ण
meaning: Eager to please others; obliging
trick: 'Kam'+'Complain' — जो कभी शिकायत न करे और हमेशा दूसरों को खुश करने के लिए बात मान ले।
examples: The hotel staff was very complaisant and fulfilled every request of the guests.
The complaisant host agreed to every suggestion his guests made about the menu.

hindi: आज्ञाकारी / नियमों का पालन करने वाला
meaning: Willing to obey rules or standards
trick: 'Comply' — जो RBI के हर नियम का चुपचाप पालन करे वो आज्ञाकारी है।
examples: All fintech apps must be fully compliant with the new data privacy laws.
Factories that are not compliant with safety norms will be fined by the inspectors.

meaning: Intended to placate or pacify
trick: 'Council' — गाँव की पंचायत हमेशा झगड़ा मिटाकर सुलह कराने वाली बात करती है।
examples: The management adopted a conciliatory tone to end the bank strike.
Her conciliatory words calmed the quarrelling neighbours and restored peace in the lane.

meaning: Giving a lot of information clearly in few words
trick: 'Con'+'Size' — Size कम कर देना यानी संक्षिप्त कर देना।
examples: Please keep your report concise and to the point.
A concise summary of the chapter is more useful than copying the whole text.

meaning: To agree with someone or something
trick: 'Kaun'+'Kar' — कौन करेगा? सबने कहा हम करेंगे = सहमत होना।
examples: All the committee members concur with the proposed changes.
The two doctors concur that the patient needs rest rather than more medicine.

meaning: To accept or forgive bad behavior
trick: 'कान'+'Done' — गलती सुनी, कान बंद किए और बोले 'Done, जाने दो' = माफ़ करना।
examples: The company does not condone any kind of corruption at the workplace.
A good school will never condone bullying, whoever the culprit may be.

meaning: A large, destructive fire
trick: 'Kaun'+'Fire'+'Station' — 'जल्दी फायर स्टेशन को फोन करो!' क्योंकि भीषण आग लगी है।
examples: A short circuit in the server room caused a massive conflagration.
A conflagration swept through the dry forest and threatened several nearby villages.

meaning: General agreement among a group
trick: 'Con'+'Sense' — जब सबकी Sense (सोच) एक जैसी हो जाए तो सर्वसम्मति बनती है।
examples: The Monetary Policy Committee reached a consensus to keep interest rates unchanged.
After hours of debate, the villagers reached a consensus to build the well near the school.

meaning: To interpret the meaning of something
trick: 'Construct' — किसी के शब्दों से दिमाग में कोई मतलब Construct करना यानी अर्थ लगाना।
examples: His silence during the inquiry was construed as an admission of guilt.
Please do not construe my silence as agreement; I simply need more time to think.

meaning: Causing or likely to cause disagreement
trick: 'Con'+'Tension' — ऐसा मुद्दा जिस पर चर्चा होते ही सबके बीच Tension और बहस शुरू हो जाए।
examples: Farm loan waivers remain a contentious issue among economists.
The location of the new stadium remains a contentious issue in the town.

meaning: The process of becoming smaller or shrinking
trick: 'Contract' — सिकुड़ने को Contract होना कहते हैं।
examples: The GDP showed a sharp contraction last quarter.
Muscle contraction in the legs causes painful cramps after a long run.

meaning: Feeling sincere regret and remorse
trick: 'Con'+'Right' — जब इंसान को समझ आ जाए कि वो गलत था और सामने वाला Right था तो पछतावा होता है।
examples: The employee looked contrite and apologized for missing the deadline.
The contrite boy handed back the stolen mangoes and promised never to do it again.

meaning: A confusing and difficult problem
trick: 'Kaun'+'Drum' — अंधेरे में कौन ड्रम बजा रहा है यह पहेली है।
examples: The central bank is facing an inflation conundrum.
How to reach the island without a boat was a conundrum the explorers could not solve.

meaning: Extremely complex and difficult to follow
trick: 'कौन-वो-लूटा?' — केस इतना उलझा कि पता ही नहीं चलता 'कौन वो लूटा?' = जटिल।
examples: The new tax rules are so convoluted that even experts are confused.
The detective's convoluted explanation had so many twists that the listeners lost track.

meaning: Abundant in supply or quantity
trick: 'Copy' — परीक्षा पास करने के लिए बहुत सारी (प्रचुर मात्रा में) कॉपियां भरकर नोट्स बनाए।
examples: She took copious notes during the financial literacy workshop.
Copious rain over the weekend filled every pond and well in the district.

meaning: Fat; having a large body
trick: 'कौर'+'Plenty' — हर बार बड़े-बड़े कौर (निवाले), Plenty खाना = मोटा।
examples: The corpulent businessman struggled to fit into the economy class seat.
The corpulent king could hardly climb the stairs to his own throne room.

hindi: पुष्टि करना / सबूत देकर समर्थन करना
meaning: To confirm or support with evidence
trick: 'Car'+'Robbery' — कार की Robbery सच में हुई थी, सीसीटीवी ने पुष्टि कर दी।
examples: The bank statement helped corroborate his claim that the payment was made.
Fingerprints on the window will corroborate the neighbour's story about the break-in.

meaning: A person's face or expression; to approve
trick: 'Counter'+'ance' — Counter पर खड़े इंसान का चेहरा।
examples: The chairman refused to countenance any delay in the reform process.
The teacher will not countenance cheating, and any student caught will be sent to the principal.

meaning: Showing no intelligence or sensitivity; crude
trick: 'Crash' — Crash की तरह बिना तमीज़ के बर्ताव।
examples: His crass jokes at the corporate event offended several senior clients.
It was crass of him to boast about his wealth at a charity dinner.

meaning: Easily deceived; too ready to believe
trick: 'Credit' — जो किसी भी अनजान आदमी की बात पर तुरंत Credit (विश्वास) कर ले वो भोला-भाला है।
examples: Fraudsters target credulous people with fake lottery messages.
The credulous traveller believed the stranger's tale and handed over his luggage.

meaning: Active at twilight
trick: 'Creep'+'Us' — सांझ और भोर में मच्छर चुपके से Creep करके Us (हमें) काटते हैं।
examples: Crepuscular animals like rabbits are most active at dawn and dusk.
Deer are largely crepuscular, grazing in the meadow at dawn and again at dusk.

meaning: A principle or standard by which something is judged
trick: 'Criteria' — Bank exam फ़ॉर्म की Eligibility Criteria (उम्र, डिग्री) = मापदंड।
examples: The primary criterion for the loan is a good credit score.
Speed is not the only criterion for judging a good bowler; accuracy matters too.

meaning: Mysterious or obscure in meaning
trick: 'Crypto'+'Currency' — क्रिप्टो करेंसी कैसे काम करती है ये रहस्यमयी बात है।
examples: The CEO sent a cryptic email about the upcoming merger.
The old map carried a cryptic message that nobody in the family could decode.

meaning: Hasty and superficial; not thorough
trick: 'Cursor' — कंप्यूटर स्क्रीन पर बस ऊपर-ऊपर से तेज़ी से Cursor घुमाना यानी सरसरी नज़र।
examples: Even a cursory glance at the balance sheet shows the company is in loss.
The guard gave the bags only a cursory check and waved the visitors through.

meaning: To reduce or cut short
trick: 'Cut'+'Tail' — कुत्ते की पूँछ (Tail) Cut करके छोटा कर देना यानी कटौती करना।
examples: The company decided to curtail its travel expenses to save money.
Heavy rain forced organisers to curtail the cultural programme by an hour.

meaning: A person or thing that is the center of attention
trick: 'Cine'+'Sure' — Cine (सिनेमा) स्टार जहाँ जाए, Sure है सबकी नज़रें उसी पर होंगी।
examples: The new CEO was the cynosure of all eyes at the bank's annual gala.
The bride, in her red silk saree, was the cynosure of the entire wedding hall.

meaning: Neat and trim in dress and appearance
trick: 'Daftar' — Dapper ≈ दफ़्तर; दफ़्तर जाने के लिए बना- ठना, स्मार्ट तैयार होकर निकलना।
examples: The dapper banker charmed every client at the conference.
The dapper old gentleman in a crisp suit and polished shoes tipped his hat to everyone.

meaning: Marked with spots or patches of color
trick: 'Dhabba'+'led' — धब्बों वाला, जैसे चितकबरी गाय।
examples: The dappled sunlight through the trees created a peaceful mood.
A dappled horse grazed quietly beside the stream, its coat speckled with grey and white.

meaning: To make someone feel intimidated
trick: 'Daant' — पापा की ज़ोरदार डांट बच्चों को डरा देती है।
examples: Do not let the difficulty of the RBI exam daunt you.
The steep climb did not daunt the young trekkers, who sang as they walked.

meaning: A severe scarcity or lack
trick: 'Death' — Death जैसी भारी कमी।
examples: There is a dearth of skilled banking professionals in rural branches.
A dearth of rainfall last year left the reservoirs almost empty.

meaning: A sudden and ignominious failure
trick: 'Dabba'+'Gol' — प्रोजेक्ट फेल हो गया और कंपनी का डब्बा गुल हो गया।
examples: After the product launch debacle, the marketing head resigned.
The team's six-goal loss in the final was a total debacle for the proud coach.

meaning: To remove someone's trousers by force
trick: 'De'+'Baggy' — किसी की ढीली Baggy पैंट जबरदस्ती De (उतार) देना।
examples: The school bullies were suspended for trying to debag a junior student.
In the old boarding school story, the boys threatened to debag the new prefect as a prank.

meaning: To lower in quality or value
trick: 'De'+'Base' — Base (नींव) को De (नीचे) करना यानी गिराना।
examples: Counterfeit currency can debase the value of real money.
Using cheap metal to mint coins would debase the currency and anger traders.

meaning: To make someone or something physically weak
trick: 'De'+'Ability' — बीमारी शरीर की Ability कम कर देती है।
examples: The prolonged strike could debilitate the national economy.
A long bout of malaria can debilitate even the strongest farmer.

meaning: Confident, stylish, and charming
trick: 'Dev'+'Air' — Dev Anand जैसा Air (अंदाज़) — स्टाइलिश, आत्मविश्वासी और चार्मिंग।
examples: The debonair host welcomed every guest at the bank's gala dinner.
The debonair actor stepped from the car in a white suit and smiled at the cameras.

meaning: To expose a belief or claim as false
trick: 'De'+'Bunk' — Bunk (बकवास) को De (हटाना) यानी झूठ पकड़ना।
examples: The RBI debunked rumors about the closure of a private bank.
The science teacher used a simple experiment to debunk the myth about the full moon.

meaning: To leave suddenly, often secretly
trick: 'De'+'Camp' — Camp से De (दूर) भाग जाना।
examples: The fraudster decamped with the investors' money overnight.
The thieves decamped before dawn, leaving behind their tools and the broken lock.

meaning: To pour liquid from one container to another
trick: 'De'+'Can' — Can से De (दूसरे बर्तन) में धीरे से डालना।
examples: The waiter decanted the aged red wine before serving.
Please decant the oil into a smaller bottle so it is easier to carry on the trip.

meaning: To destroy a large portion of something
trick: 'Desh'+'Mita' — Desi-mate ≈ देश मिटा दे; ऐसा तूफ़ान जो देश का बड़ा हिस्सा मिटा दे।
examples: The recession decimated the small business sector across the country.
The disease did decimate the cattle herd, leaving the farmer with barely a dozen animals.

meaning: To decode or understand something difficult
trick: 'De'+'Cipher' — कोड (Cipher) को De (हटाना) करना यानी अर्थ निकालना।
examples: It is difficult to decipher the doctor's handwriting.
Archaeologists spent years trying to decipher the strange symbols carved on the cave wall.

meaning: Polite, proper, and respectful behavior
trick: 'Decor' — जैसे घर का Decor सलीकेदार होता है, वैसे ही सलीकेदार और शालीन व्यवहार।
examples: Bank officers are expected to maintain decorous behavior with customers.
The guests remained decorous throughout the long ceremony, speaking softly and sitting upright.

meaning: A fake object used to lure someone into a trap
trick: 'Dekho'+'Koi' — "देखो कोई!" कहकर जाल में फँसाना।
examples: The police used a decoy car to catch the ATM thieves.
Hunters placed a wooden decoy duck on the lake to attract the real birds.

meaning: Worn out and ruined by age
trick: 'Crack'+'Pit' — दीवार में Crack, फ़र्श में Pit (गड्ढा) — पुराना जर्जर मकान।
examples: The decrepit bank building was finally demolished for renovation.
The decrepit bridge creaked so badly that nobody dared cross it after the rains.

meaning: To spoil the surface or appearance of something
trick: 'De'+'Face' — Face (चेहरा) बिगाड़ देना।
examples: Vandals defaced the historic bank building with spray paint.
Fans were warned not to deface the stadium walls with paint after the victory.

meaning: To damage someone's reputation
trick: 'De'+'Fame' — Fame (प्रसिद्धि) को De (खत्म) कर देना।
examples: The journalist was sued for trying to defame the bank's chairman.
The false pamphlet was written to defame the honest headmaster and force him out.

meaning: To throw someone or something out of a window
trick: 'De Fenk'+'Straight' — "दे फेंक! Straight खिड़की से बाहर!"
examples: The angry shareholders threatened to defenestrate the entire board.
In the history lesson, we learned that angry rebels once chose to defenestrate the king's envoys from a castle window.

meaning: To postpone or delay
trick: 'Der'+'Phir' — 'आज देर हो गई ये मीटिंग फिर कभी करेंगे' कहकर काम आगे के लिए टाल देना।
examples: The bank agreed to defer his EMI payments for three months.
The college agreed to defer the admission of the injured athlete until the next year.

meaning: Respectful submission or yielding to another
trick: 'Reference' — बड़े व्यक्ति का Reference देना यानी सम्मान देना।
examples: He stood up out of deference when the chairman entered the room.
The students spoke with deference to the old professor, listening quietly to each word.

meaning: To desecrate or make dirty
trick: 'Dee Phaila' — गंदगी दी फैला = अपवित्र करना।
examples: Vandals tried to defile the temple donation box during the festival.
It is a crime to defile the holy river by dumping rubbish into it.

meaning: A general fall in prices; increase in money's value
trick: 'De'+'Inflate' — फूला हुआ गुब्बारा पिचकना यानी बाजार में पैसों और कीमतों का घट जाना।
examples: Prolonged deflation can damage the economy just as much as hyperinflation.
During deflation, shoppers delay purchases because they expect prices to fall even further.

meaning: To turn aside or cause to change direction
trick: 'De'+'Reflect' — Reflect करने वाली चीज़ को De (दूसरी तरफ) मोड़ना।
examples: The spokesperson tried to deflect questions about the audit failures.
The goalkeeper managed to deflect the powerful shot over the crossbar at the last second.

meaning: To cheat someone out of money or rights
trick: 'De'+'Fraud' — पूरी Fraud (धोखाधड़ी) से De (लूट) लेना।
examples: The fake investment scheme defrauded thousands of poor families.
The gang tried to defraud elderly villagers by selling them worthless land.

meaning: To pay a portion of the cost
trick: 'De'+'Free' — खर्च De (दे) दिया, Trip Free!
examples: The company agreed to defray the travel expenses of the recruits.
The club will defray the cost of the bus for players travelling to the away match.

meaning: Neatly skillful and quick in movement
trick: 'Deaf' — भले Deaf है लेकिन मशीन सुधारने में बहुत कुशल है।
examples: The politician handled the controversial questions with deft answers.
With a deft flick of her wrist, the chef flipped the pancake perfectly.

meaning: No longer existing or functioning
trick: 'De'+'Function' — जिस मशीन या कंपनी ने Function (काम) करना बंद कर दिया हो।
examples: Thousand-rupee notes became defunct after the 2016 demonetization.
The defunct factory on the hill has been silent since the last workers left years ago.

meaning: Extremely delicious or delightful
trick: 'Dil'+'Chahta' — जिसे देखते ही दिल खाने को ललचाए वो बहुत स्वादिष्ट है।
examples: The bakery next to our branch sells delectable pastries.
The grandmother served a delectable plate of sweets that disappeared within minutes.

meaning: Great pleasure and enjoyment
trick: 'Delight'+'ation' — Delight (खुशी) देने वाला आनंद।
examples: The chef prepared the dish with great care for the guests' delectation.
The garden was planted for the delectation of visitors, who strolled among the roses and jasmine.

meaning: To describe or outline precisely
trick: 'Line' — चारों तरफ Line खींच कर विस्तार से वर्णन करना।
examples: The manager asked him to delineate the new marketing strategy.
The surveyor used white stakes to delineate the boundary between the two farms.

meaning: To dissolve by absorbing moisture
trick: 'De' + 'Liquesce' (Liquid) — नमी सोखकर पिघल जाना।
examples: The old manuscript began to deliquesce in the damp basement.
Left in the humid air, the salt crystals began to deliquesce into a thick puddle.

meaning: A political leader who gains support by appealing to emotions and prejudices
trick: 'Dimag'+'Aag' — ऐसा नेता जो लोगों के दिमाग में भावनाओं की आग भड़का कर वोट बटोरे।
examples: A true statesman thinks of the economy, while a demagogue only plays with emotions.
The demagogue stirred the crowd with angry slogans but offered no real solution to their problems.

meaning: Shy, modest, and reserved
trick: 'De' (नीचे) + 'Mure' (मोड़) — नज़रें नीचे मोड़ना।
examples: Despite being a famous actress, she has a very demure personality.
The demure bride lowered her eyes and spoke only in a soft whisper.

meaning: To criticize unfairly; to disparage
trick: 'Down'+'Grade' — किसी की इमेज या काम का Grade जानबूझकर Down करना यानी बदनाम करना।
examples: You should not denigrate your competitors to sell your own product.
Good sportsmen never denigrate the opposing team after a narrow defeat.

meaning: The final resolution of a story or sequence
trick: 'The'+'End'+'Moment' — किसी फिल्म या नाटक का सबसे आखिरी (अंतिम परिणाम वाला) मोमेंट।
examples: The merger negotiations reached a happy denouement late last night.
The denouement of the mystery came when the butler finally confessed in the library.

meaning: To express strong disapproval
trick: 'Appreciate' का उल्टा — निंदा करना।
examples: The new policy was heavily deprecated by the labor unions.
Doctors deprecate the use of antibiotics for simple colds, since they do not help.

meaning: To mock or laugh at contemptuously
trick: 'Ride' — खराब Ride करोगे तो पीछे बैठे दोस्त मज़ाक उड़ाएंगे।
examples: It is unprofessional to deride the ideas of your junior colleagues.
The crowd began to deride the singer when he forgot the words to the anthem.

meaning: Imitative of other work; not original
trick: 'Derive' — किसी चीज़ से Derive (निकला हुआ) लेकिन नया नहीं।
examples: Critics dismissed the film as a derivative work with no fresh ideas.
The band's new album felt derivative, borrowing every melody from older, more famous songs.

meaning: Showing a critical or disrespectful attitude
trick: 'Dhero Gaali' — ढेरों गालियाँ देना = अपमानजनक बातें करना।
examples: Making derogatory comments about competitors is against company policy.
The coach was suspended for making derogatory remarks about the rival team's players.

meaning: To remove moisture from; to dry out completely
trick: 'Desi'+'Cake' — देसी धूप में रख-रख कर नारियल को पूरा सुखा दिया।
examples: Severe drought can desiccate thousands of acres of fertile farmland.
The hot desert wind can quickly desiccate fruits left in the open sun.

meaning: Something desired or needed
trick: 'Desire'+'Item' — सबसे ज़रूरी चाहत वाली चीज़।
examples: Clean drinking water is the primary desideratum for the village.
A reliable bus service is a desideratum for the hill town's isolated villages.

meaning: In low spirits from loss of hope
trick: 'Desh'+'Pond' — गाँव का तालाब सूख गया तो सारे किसान निराश और हताश होकर बैठ गए।
examples: Do not feel despondent if you fail in your first attempt; keep trying.
The despondent farmer stared at his ruined crops, seeing no hope for the season.

meaning: A ruler with absolute power who uses it oppressively
trick: 'Desh'+'Pati' — जो खुद को पूरे देश का पति (मालिक) समझे और मनमानी करे।
examples: The branch manager ruled like a despot, ignoring all feedback.
The despot jailed anyone who criticised him and ruled the island by fear.

meaning: Lacking a plan, purpose, or enthusiasm
trick: 'De'+'Result' — बिना टारगेट के असंगत काम करोगे तो Result नहीं मिलेगा।
examples: The police made a desultory attempt to find the missing files.
The students made a desultory effort to clean the classroom and soon wandered off.

meaning: To become progressively worse
trick: 'Terror'+'Rate' — टेरर का रेट बढ़ने से हालात खराब होते हैं।
examples: The asset quality of the bank began to deteriorate quickly.
If the patient's condition continues to deteriorate, he will be moved to the intensive care unit.

meaning: Something that discourages an action
trick: 'Darr'+'Rent' — इतना ऊँचा Rent देखकर लोग डर कर रुक जाते हैं = रोकने वाली चीज़।
examples: High penalty fees act as a strong deterrent against late credit card payments.
A loud alarm is often a good deterrent against burglars trying to enter a house.

meaning: To move away from an established course or standard
trick: 'De'+'Via' — तय Via (रास्ते) से हटकर De (दूर) चला गया।
examples: The committee did not deviate from the RBI's monetary policy framework.
The pilot had to deviate from the planned route to avoid a thunderstorm.

meaning: Showing a skillful, dishonest way of achieving something
trick: 'De'+'Via' — सीधे Via (रास्ते) से हटकर चालाकी से जाना।
examples: The fraudster used a devious scheme to lure investors into a trap.
The devious servant secretly sold the master's grain and blamed the poor cook.

meaning: Light, delicate and translucent
trick: 'Diya'+'Fanoos' — दिये के फ़ानूस का पतला काँच, जिसमें से रोशनी आर-पार दिखे।
examples: She wore a diaphanous scarf that caught the sunlight.
Diaphanous curtains stirred in the breeze and let soft light fill the room.

hindi: कड़ी निंदा / तीखा भाषण या हमला
meaning: A bitter, abusive criticism
trick: 'Daya'+'Tribe' — बिना किसी Daya (दया) के किसी पर शब्दों से तीखा प्रहार और कड़ी निंदा करना।
examples: The union leader launched a long diatribe against the new pension rules.
The old man launched into a diatribe about rude teenagers and noisy motorbikes.

meaning: A division into two sharply contrasting parts
trick: 'Do'+'Cut' — किसी चीज़ को Cut करके दो बिल्कुल अलग और विपरीत भागों में बाँट देना।
examples: There is a sharp dichotomy between the booming stock market and slow job growth.
There is a clear dichotomy between the calm village life and the chaos of the city.

meaning: An authoritative statement or pronouncement
trick: 'Dictate'+'Tum' — बॉस Dictate करता है: "Tum यही करोगे!" = आधिकारिक कथन।
examples: The dictum 'customer is king' is followed by every successful bank.
My grandmother's favourite dictum was that honest work never goes unrewarded, and she lived by it.

meaning: Lacking self-confidence; shy
trick: 'Diff'+'Confident' — Confident से Different (उल्टा) = आत्मविश्वास की कमी, संकोची।
examples: He was too diffident to express his opinion in the meeting.
The diffident new student sat at the back and rarely raised her hand, even when she knew the answer.

meaning: To spread over a wide area or to reduce tension
trick: 'Fuse' — बल्ब से रोशनी चारों तरफ फैलती है या बम का फ्यूज़ निकाल कर तनाव कम किया जाता है।
examples: New branches were opened to diffuse banking services across remote villages.
The counsellor used soft music and gentle humour to diffuse the tension between the two quarrelling cousins.

meaning: A temporary departure from the main subject
trick: 'Di'+'Progress' — Progress से हटकर किसी और तरफ भटकना।
examples: The speaker's constant digressions made the lecture hard to follow.
After a brief digression about his school days, the grandfather returned to the story of the flood.

meaning: In a state of disrepair or ruin
trick: 'Dil pe Peeda' — टूटा-फूटा पुश्तैनी घर देखकर दिल पे पीड़ा होती है।
examples: The bank branch was shifted because the old building was dilapidated.
Villagers feared the dilapidated bridge would collapse, since its rusted rails and cracked planks had never been repaired.

meaning: A person who takes up an activity as a hobby but without serious commitment
trick: 'Dil' + 'Tante' — दिल से सिर्फ शौकिया तौर पर कुछ करने वाला।
examples: He was dismissed as a dilettante who had no deep knowledge of finance.
Critics called the actor a dilettante because he tried painting, pottery and poetry but never mastered any of them.

meaning: Showing care and effort in work
trick: 'Dilli'+'Gent' — दिल्ली के लोग काम में बहुत मेहनती होते हैं।
examples: You need to be highly diligent to clear the SBI PO mains.
A diligent gardener, she watered every plant at dawn and pulled out weeds before the sun grew hot.

meaning: A mournful song for the dead
trick: 'Dard'+'Geet' — दर्द से भरा हुआ शोक गीत जो किसी की मृत्यु पर गाया जाता है।
examples: Critics wrote that the high tax rate would sing a dirge for small startups.
As the ship slowly sank, the band on the deck played a quiet dirge for the lost sailors.

meaning: To free someone from a mistaken belief
trick: 'This'+'Ab Use' — "This (गलत बात) अब Use मत करो" — किसी का भ्रम दूर करना।
examples: The RBI clarification disabused investors of the fear of a bank run.
A short visit to the factory disabused the journalist of her belief that the workers were unhappy.

meaning: Having or showing good judgment
trick: 'Dis'+'Scanning' — जो बात को Scanning की तरह ध्यान से देखे वो विवेकी है।
examples: A discerning investor always reads the offer document carefully.
The discerning chef could tell at one taste that the sauce had been made with stale cream.

meaning: To confuse or disconcert
trick: 'Disco' (डिस्को) + 'Bob' + 'Late' — डिस्को में लेट होकर इतना डांस किया कि दिमाग ही उलझ गया (घबरा गया)।
examples: The unexpected audit discombobulated the branch manager.
The sudden power cut during his presentation discombobulated the young engineer, who forgot what he wanted to say.

meaning: Disagreeing or not in harmony
trick: 'Disco'+'Dance' — डिस्को में बिना ताल-मेल के डांस करना बेमेल है।
examples: There were a few discordant voices in the board meeting regarding the merger.
A discordant note from the violin spoiled an otherwise perfect evening of classical music at the hall.

meaning: A difference between things that should be the same
trick: 'Disk'+'Pan' — डिस्क और पैन के आकार में अंतर है।
examples: The auditor found a huge discrepancy in the accounts.
The teacher noticed a discrepancy between the marks on the answer sheet and those entered in the register.

meaning: To deprive someone of a right or privilege
trick: 'Dis'+'Franchise' — किसी से Franchise (वोट देने का अधिकार) छीन लेना।
examples: Lack of digital access can disenfranchise poor citizens from government schemes.
Strict identity rules threatened to disenfranchise thousands of elderly voters who had no birth certificates to show.

meaning: Not candid or sincere; pretending to be innocent
trick: 'Dis'+'Genuine' — जो इंसान अंदर से Genuine (सच्चा) न हो बल्कि कपटी और नाटक करने वाला हो।
examples: It was disingenuous of the broker to claim he knew nothing about the hidden fees.
Her disingenuous smile fooled nobody, because everyone knew she had planned the surprise party herself.

meaning: Depressing, gloomy, or causing sadness
trick: 'Dis' (नहीं) + 'Smile' — जिस दिन चेहरे पर Smile न हो, ऐसा उदास और निराशाजनक दिन।
examples: The quarterly earnings report was extremely dismal.
After weeks of rain, the dismal weather made the small hill town look grey and lifeless.

hindi: निंदा करना / तुच्छ समझना / नीचा दिखाना
meaning: To belittle or speak of in a derogatory way
trick: 'This'+'Par'+'Age' — 'इस उम्र में तुमसे कुछ नहीं होगा' कहकर किसी को छोटा दिखाना और निंदा करना।
examples: A good leader never tries to disparage the efforts of his team members.
Rival players often try to disparage a champion's skill, but his record answers every unfair comment.

meaning: A great difference or inequality
trick: 'This'+'Party' — दो पार्टियों के उसूलों में असमानता।
examples: There is a massive income disparity between urban and rural areas.
The gulf of disparity between the two schools was obvious in their classrooms, libraries and playgrounds.

meaning: Not influenced by strong emotion; impartial
trick: 'Dis'+'Passion' — जो अपनी भावनाओं को साइड में रखकर बिल्कुल ठंडे दिमाग और निष्पक्ष भाव से फैसला ले।
examples: Auditors must make a dispassionate analysis of the company's accounts.
The judge gave a dispassionate verdict, ignoring the angry shouts of the crowd outside the courtroom.

meaning: To conceal one's true motives or feelings
trick: 'Dis'+'Resemble' — जैसा अंदर है वैसा न दिखना यानी अपनी असली भावना या इरादे छुपाना।
examples: The CEO tried to dissemble his anxiety when reporters asked about the debt.
The witness tried to dissemble, pretending he had not been at the scene when the fire began.

meaning: To spread widely (information, knowledge)
trick: 'This'+'Seminar' — इस सेमिनार के ज़रिए नई नीतियों का ज्ञान फैलाया जाएगा।
examples: The RBI uses its website to disseminate financial information.
Volunteers walked from door to door to disseminate news about the free vaccination camp in the colony.

meaning: Disagreement with a widely held view
trick: 'Dis'+'Consent' — जब आपकी किसी फैसले से Consent (सहमति) न हो यानी असहमति जताना।
examples: Two members of the panel expressed dissent over the rate hike decision.
The senator voiced dissent on the new highway plan, arguing that it would destroy the forest.

meaning: To scatter or gradually disappear
trick: 'Dis'+'Sip'+'Ate' — छोटी-छोटी Sip (घूंट) और Ate (खाना) से पैसा धीरे-धीरे खत्म हो जाता है।
examples: Inflation can dissipate household savings over time.
By evening the morning fog had begun to dissipate, and the mountain peaks slowly came into view.

meaning: Lack of harmony or agreement
trick: 'Dis'+'Sonance' (Sound) — जब Sound (आवाज़) Dis (अलग) हो जाए तो बेसुरापन पैदा होता है।
examples: There is a cognitive dissonance between the company's words and actions.
Listeners felt a jarring dissonance as the cheerful song played over the news of the tragedy.

meaning: To persuade someone not to do something
trick: 'Is'+'Swaad' — "इस स्वाद के चक्कर में जंक फ़ूड मत खाओ" — किसी को काम करने से मना करना।
examples: The RBI tried to dissuade retail investors from putting money in risky crypto assets.
Her parents tried to dissuade her from sailing alone, but she had already made up her mind.

meaning: A wildly enthusiastic speech or piece of writing
trick: 'Dil'+'Ram' — दिल से "राम-राम" गाते हुए पूरे जोश वाला भजन या भाषण।
examples: His speech turned into a dithyramb about the glory of the company.
The fan's dithyramb about his favourite cricketer went on for pages and praised even the man's haircut.

hindi: अलग-अलग / भिन्न दिशाओं में जाने वाला
meaning: Tending to move apart from a common point
trick: 'Diversion' — जब सड़क पर डायवर्जन आता है तो गाड़ियां अलग-अलग दिशाओं में मुड़ जाती हैं।
examples: The two economists hold divergent views on how to control inflation.
The brothers took divergent paths after school, one becoming a farmer and the other a lawyer in Delhi.

hindi: भेद खोलना / गुप्त जानकारी प्रकट करना
meaning: To make known private information
trick: 'Dil'+'Ugal' — दिल में छुपा हुआ सारा राज़ बाहर उगल देना यानी भेद खोलना।
